metadata.description: Marketplace for the OPM engineering workflow plugin for Claude Code

plugins.name: opm
plugins.description: An opinionated engineering workflow: brainstorm, plan, TDD execution with fresh-context subagents, verification, captured learnings. Includes UI design skills with visual QA and an explainer-video skill. Lean reviewers, stack patterns and six light safety hooks. Visual QA uses the project's Playwright when present; otherwise it asks before downloading Playwright, axe-core and Chromium (about 150 MB) into ~/.opm/design-tools. The explainer video's neural voice (edge-tts) sends narration text to a Microsoft cloud service unless the local OS voice is chosen.
